name: SB Restaurant Gampen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to SB Restaurant Gampen in Tirol** Nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, **SB Restaurant Gampen** invites you to savor authentic **Tiroler** hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this family-run gem offers a warm atmosphere where traditional flavors meet modern comfort. Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**—fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake—served with fresh fruit compote or a dusting of powdered sugar. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Tiroler** coffee or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** from the region. For hearty appetites, try our **Tiroler Gröstl**—a rustic hash of potatoes, onions, and crispy bacon—topped with a fried egg and melted cheese. Or enjoy a classic **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork), slow-cooked to perfection with **Tiroler** spices and served with **Kraut** and dumplings. Seasonal specialties include fresh trout from the **Inn River**, wild game dishes, and homemade **Apfelstrudel** for dessert. The wine list features local **Tiroler** wines, as well as fine Austrian selections. Whether you're exploring the **Zillertal**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply taking a break from the road, **SB Restaurant Gampen** is the perfect place to refuel with genuine **Tiroler** charm. **Reservations recommended**—especially on weekends and holidays. We look forward to welcoming you! --- **Visit our website** **
